title: The spec of a Seed document: records of one object, written when the template is installed
$comment: Exactly one of records and source: PackageChecker says so in words a schema error cannot.

key.description: The name of a unique field of the object: it names each record, for references and upgrades

mode.description: once (default): the records belong to the user once installed. managed: upgrades keep them in line with the template

records.description: The records, each a map of field names to values

source.description: A CSV file of the package: a header of field names, then one record per line
